units.source_text: 藤大纳言是太政大臣（葵姬之兄）的异母弟。

en.t: Fuji Dainagon was the younger half-brother of the Chancellor, who was Princess Aoi's elder brother.

units.source_text: 大纳言官位低，与公主不称，故表面上说当家臣，其实想当夫婿。

en.t: Because the Dainagon's rank was too low to be a suitable match for the princess, he outwardly said he would serve as a retainer, but in truth he hoped to become her husband.
